title: Last chunk is dropped in uploader
prompt:
test_given.py fails. Find the bug in chunker.py and fix it.

chunks(data, size) splits a bytes-like value into consecutive chunks of at most
`size` bytes, in order, with no bytes lost and none duplicated. The final chunk
may be shorter. Empty input yields no chunks. size must be a positive int, else
ValueError.

Only chunker.py should change.
